text: DSH MiniTUI 是 Deepseek Harness 的终端界面插件，通过 Cordis profile 接入 DSH，并以键盘为主操作工作区中的 Agent 会话。它提供终端聊天窗口、流式 Markdown 回复显示、工作区内会话切换或新建，以及模型和推理等级选择；输入框支持多行编辑，按 Alt+Enter 发送。创建会话时还能选择 Agent 预设与工作区权限。适合希望在终端中与 DSH Agent 对话、减少图形界面操作的开发者。使用前需要已有 DSH 环境并按 README 编译安装；代码未声明独立 API 密钥配置。

DSH MiniTUI is a keyboard-driven terminal chat for Deepseek Harness. It renders streaming Markdown replies, supports workspace session switching or creation, and lets users select a model and reasoning effort. Send multiline input with Alt+Enter. It requires an existing DSH setup.
我想在终端里直接和 DSH 的 Agent 聊天。
I want to switch or start a DSH session from the keyboard in my current workspace.
能不能在终端界面里切换模型和推理等级？
DSH MiniTUI 的功能「终端聊天」：在终端布局中编辑多行消息并查看对话，助手回复以流式 Markdown 形式渲染；按 Alt+Enter 发送输入。
DSH MiniTUI 的功能「会话与模型选择」：通过 /session 切换当前工作区的会话或新建会话，通过 /model 选择 DeepSeek 模型及推理等级。

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · 项目概述：这是一个为 `Deepseek Harness`(`dsh`) 设计的 `TUI` 前端，和目前主流的 `dsh-TUI` 项目相比，这个项目会更加*简陋*。因为本人仅仅是个人开发者，没有团队，所以功能不是很复杂，界面也不是很华丽。这个项目是本人做的第一个 `TypeScript` 项目，整体框架由人工编写，有些功能实在写不出来，让 AI 帮忙实现。

需要注意的是，开发环境是 `Ubuntu 22.04`，且使用了 `neo-blessed` 第三方库，可能在 `Windows` 上的适配可能会有未知 bug 。`Windows` 用户请使用 `WSL2` (感觉绝大多数使用 `dsh` 的 `Windows` 用户都会用 `WSL` 吧)。

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · 功能介绍：#### 输入区快捷键

| 功能 | 快捷键 |
  | ----- | ----- |
  | 发送 | Alt+Enter |
  | 换行 | Enter |
  | 补全 | Tab |
  | 复制 | Ctrl+Shift+C |
  | 粘贴 | Ctrl+Shift+V |
  | 退出 | Ctrl+C |

这里设计成发送需要按下 `Alt+Enter` 才能触发，因为在与 Agent的交流中，使用 *Markdown* 格式效率更高，但是大多数和 AI 交流的场景按下 `Enter` 键都会直接发送，导致用户无法输入完整且清晰的 *Markdown* 语句。因此在这个 `TUI` 界面里，`Enter` 仅用于换行，不会用于发送消息。

#### 输入区命令

除了 `dsh` 中原本的命令外，本项目还引入了一些其他的命令来实现一些功能。

- `/session`

本项目为了应对不使用点击切换会话的情况，新增了一个 `/session` 命令用于切换**同一个工作区目录下**的会话或者创建会话。

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · 功能介绍：千万注意：无法切换到当前工作区以外的会话，这需要你先退出 `TUI` 界面，切换到你需要的目录，再打开 `TUI` 界面。

- `/model`

虽然 `dsh` 的 Web 端本身也有这个命令，但是不同的前端仍然需要重新实现，实际流程可能不同，因此在这里指出。

本项目的 `/model` 命令用于切换模型和推理等级。需要注意的是，目前只支持 Deepseek 本家的模型，不支持外接的其他模型。

#### 自定义

本项目其实没有提供多少自定义功能，只有一些颜色和创建会话时的默认配置。第一次运行插件后，会在插件的根目录下生成一个 `userconfig.json` 文件。看变量名称你也能看懂是什么意思(毕竟 `json` 格式不支持写注释)。如果填写了不存在的值会导致插件打不开哦。

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · 安装指南：本项目暂时还没有开源到 `npm` 仓库的想法，所以暂时只能通过 GitHub 仓库获取源码自己用 `tsc` 编译。整体的过程如下：

```bash
  git clone https://github.com/AncientMoon114/dsh-minitui
  cd ./dsh-minitui-0.1.0/
  npm install
  npx tsc

然后就可以在项目目录里通过以下命令打开 `TUI` 界面：

```bash
  dsh --profile minitui
  ```

如果您嫌弃这样调用太麻烦，我的建议是修改 `~/.bashrc` ，添加缩写：

```
  alias dsh-minitui='dsh --profile minitui'
  ```

如果遇到什么问题，可以在 `Issue` 界面提出。本人开发自理尚浅，如果给您带来了糟糕的体验，还请理性批评。

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · 使用依赖：本项目使用了一些第三方库来实现前端的渲染，包括 `neo-blessed` 、`marked` 、`marked-terminal`和 `streammark` 等。

之所以在这里指出这一点，是因为我在实现过程中发现 `streammark` 在渲染时会导致代码块的边界显示异常，因此我手动修改了这个第三方库来实现更美观的显示效果。我已经通过 `patch-package` 工具打上了补丁，所以用户在安装依赖时是可以正常安装的，但是在之后的更新或者用户的全局环境变量中可能会有冲突，在这里指出这种可能性。

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Project Discription：This is a `TUI` front-end project designed for `Deepseek Harness`(`dsh`). Compared to main-stream `TUI` project, `dsh-TUI`, this project is much more simple, because I am a individual developer without team support. Thus, the function of this project is not complicated like other mature pojects. Bsesides, this is the first `TypeScript` project I've worked on. The main frame is written by human while some functions are too complicated for me so that I called AI for help. So, it is definitely a AI assisted project.

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Project Discription：Pay attention that the developing platform is `Ubuntu 22.04` and I use `neo-blessed` which might cause bug on `Windows`. After all, most of Windows developers of `dsh` need to use `WSL2` for sure.

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Project feature：The biggest different between this project and `dsh-TUI` is *clear*. This project is designed for **coders**, especially after-end coders. I think `TUI` surfaces should be clear and mainly interact with users by keyboard. So there is nowhere for users to click in this project. All works can be down with keyboard.

Besides, the user interface refers to `OpenCode`, which is clean without artificial fonts or desktop pets. There are only input box, chat box and a control panel.

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Project feature：Current function incudes only communicating with Agent. I might add more functions to control panel as long as they are convenient for coders. However, I would never add slick (in bad meaning) functions to it.

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Function introduction：#### Shortcut key in input box

| Function | Shorcut key |
  | ----- | ----- |
  | Send | Alt+Enter |
  | Return | Enter |
  | Complete | Tab |
  | Copy | Ctrl+Shift+C |
  | Paste | Ctrl+Shift+V |
  | Exit | Ctrl+C |

It is specially designed that user needs to press `Alt+Enter` to send, because using *Markdown* is more efficient than plain text in communication with AI Agent while most applications prevent users to type return in the input area.

#### Commands in input box

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Function introduction：The `/model` command of this project is used to change model and reasoning effort. It is reminded that it only supports *Deepseek Models*, including `deepseek-flash` and `deepseek-v4-pro`. Other models like Claude or ChatGPT are not supported.

#### Self customize

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Function introduction：Actually, there aren't much things to customize. Several colors and tolarent agent config of sessions when you create them can be customize in `userconfig.json`. This file will be automatically created when you run the `miniTUI` plugin at first time. You can understand what the config choice meanings through their name.

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Quick start：It is unfortunate that currently this project is not intended to emit to `npm`. So the only way to use is to get source code from GitHub and compile it yourself. Operations like below:

```bash
  git clone https://github.com/AncientMoon114/dsh-minitui
  cd ./dsh-minitui-0.1.0/
  npm install
  npx tsc

Then you can open `TUI` in your project workspace like this:

```bash
  dsh --profile minitui
  ```

If this is too fussy for you, I recommend you to add abbreviation in `~/.bashrc`:

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Quick start：```
  alias dsh-minitui='dsh --profile minitui'
  ```

If you meet any problem, please raise it in `Issue` part. I have to explain that I am a green-hand in coding. If this project brings you horrible experience, please critic me rationally.

@dsh-external/dsh-minitui README · Dependence used：This project uses several third-party libs to render the front-end interface, including `neo-blessed`, `marked`, `marked-terminal` and `streammark`.

I have to point it out that I have altered `streammark` lib because it causes bug in rendering the corner of code blocks. I added patch through `patch-package` tool so that it can work well when user installs it. However, if you have `streammark` lib in your global environment it may cause crack.
